title: Seasonal assessment and characterization of microplastics in two urban (Balu) and peri-urban (Shitalakshya) rivers of Bangladesh
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,39443-39460
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05599G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Vaskur Kanti Roy, Md Numaer Tahnun, Hridoy Roy, Rumana Afrin, Md. Shahinoor Islam, Md. Mujibur Rahman
This study investigates microplastic pollution in several locations of the Balu and Shitalakshya Rivers of Dhaka across seasons. Higher concentrations were observed in dry-season sediments. SEM and FTIR revealed polymer types and morphologies.
